title: Decision: justfile pre-commit quality gates
description: justfile defines 'check' target that runs fmt, clippy, and test in sequence. This codifies the exact pre-commit workflow required (format, lint with all warnings as errors, full test suite). Makes it impossible for contributors to forget a quality gate step.
notes: opinion: no engineering basis — rationale note affirming justfile 'check' target is correct. Not a finding. No action needed.
